body.statement: Let \(X\sim\operatorname{Bin}(N,p)\), where \(N\geq1\), \(p\in[0,1]\), and \(0<\gamma<1\).  The two-sided equal-tailed Clopper--Pearson interval with total noncoverage \(\gamma\), obtained by inversion of the two binomial tails, contains \(p\) with probability at least \(1-\gamma\).

source.locator: Sections 1--2, binomial-tail inversion defining the two fiducial limits
